paras: The Alpha-N Carbon Clubsport Front Lip is designed to fit the BMW M2 G87 2023+, and is available in Australia through iilumolab. Developed and manufactured in Germany by Alpha-N Performance, a brand with deep roots in BMW motorsport, this one-piece Clubsport front lip pushes beyond the traditional GT-style splitter with a more aggressive aerodynamic profile and functional airflow design.

Compared to the standard GT-style lip, the Clubsport features a deeper chin spoiler that extends further forward to enhance the M2's visual presence and improve front-end airflow management. Integrated aero channels along the outer edges help direct air away from the front fascia, and the side air outlet design contributes to improved pressure management around the bumper. The result is a front-end upgrade that transforms the appearance of the G87 M2 while bringing purposeful motorsport design cues to the street.
